name: Proton Saga (1985)
creation_method: Original Blender procedural panel meshes with user-supplied reference-image textures
accuracy_notes: Reconstructed as separate left and right front-wing, door and rear-quarter meshes with a lower cabin and proportioned wheels, using the supplied 1985 Saga images as visual guides. The headlamps, indicators, tail lamps and wheel surfaces use local image-derived textures. The reference images are embedded in the GLB in compressed form. The geometry, reflections, cabin and trim remain approximations: it is not a factory scan, a dimensionally certified vehicle or a 100% photographic match.

attribution.credit: Original procedural vehicle meshes and scene created for Blender-3D-Gallery.
User-provided Proton Saga 1985 Heritage Showcase and 1985 Proton Saga Heritage Showcase: image-derived lamp and wheel textures; compressed full reference images are embedded in the GLB.
